snippet.title: Camp Enderwood Official Trailer – Minecraft DLC
snippet.description:
The summer camp of your dreams (and nightmares) awaits in this free DLC*! Earn marshmallows and roast the elusive s’mores by participating in activities like parkour, archery, and hide’n’hunt. Pursue bigger thrills by venturing outside the camp into the spooky woods! But be warned – real dangers lurk in the dark.

Learn more about the Camp Enderwood DLC: https://www.minecraft.net/article/welcome-camp-enderwood

*DLC requires Minecraft: Bedrock Edition (sold separately). Online multiplayer functionality may require a platform-specific subscription.
